claim_boundary: Official public records for one Korean corporate wheelchair-fencing team, not a national census or a complete competition archive. The snapshot has 77 event or training entries from 2016-2026 and 458 parsable athlete-weapon or team-weapon placements. Athlete names are replaced by stable project-local codes. Placements are not bouts, scores, touches, independent athletes, or causal training outcomes. The portal description says 2016-2024, but the downloaded file itself includes 2025 and 2026 rows; the file is treated as authoritative for row coverage.
